## What this changes

A short description of the change and why it is needed. Link the issue it addresses, if any (e.g. `Closes #12`).

## How it was checked

- [ ] Ran it locally from a static server
- [ ] Wallpaper (`/`) still loads and animates
- [ ] Hero scenes (`/hero/`) still load and animate
- [ ] Checked with the panel shown and hidden (`H` or `?ui=0`)
- [ ] Browsers tried:

## Screenshots

For visual changes, before and after, taken with the same `?t=` value, and the page URLs.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`<type>(<scope>): <summary>`)
- [ ] No build step or package dependencies added
- [ ] Comments explain the code, not the change history
- [ ] New panel labels have Chinese text in `i18n.js`
- [ ] README updated if settings, URL parameters or the web component changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated under **Unreleased** for user-facing changes
